manifest.protocol: One profile per method/scenario. Same maximum allowance including 5 s arming; early completion leaves unused time. Model-based return reserve is common to methods.
manifest.pairing: Same field, clock and channel realization by scenario; independent digital measurement-noise streams by method. Raw samples are not independent experimental replicates.
manifest.primary_contrast: response/forward minus medium/raw, separately by direction; adaptation-only and estimator-only contrasts also reported.
manifest.reconstruction: Raw digitized samples versus forward-fit support temperature at its filtered-regressor support depth. Current-depth extrapolation is diagnostic, not a hidden truth shift.
manifest.scoring: Median bins on fixed 0.10–0.90 m grid; full-profile RMSE undefined if any required bin is missing. Boundary: strongest binned temperature-gradient peak in 0.20–0.80 m, >=2 C/m, optional local parabolic interpolation. Failures remain in denominators.
manifest.uncertainty: Scenario-paired bootstrap conditional on joint boundary success. Failure counts and coverage accompany conditional errors; no calibrated onboard confidence interval is claimed.

paired.interpretation: Negative favours response method; interval is conditional on BOTH detectors succeeding, not all missions.
